educationalGoal: This course aims to cultivate design engineers with a solid foundation in engineering skills and acquired design competencies. Students will be able to design novel product appearances and add value to product exteriors without altering technical performance, while integrating problem-solving across functional components, exterior elements, and their intersections.
advice: Course Overview This course classifies the styling process into key elements and explains each through representative examples using photographs and illustrations. Course Content Key topics include the objectives and evaluation of product styling; essential styling elements such as visual themes, silhouette, proportion, form, lines, volume, surface, color, and materials; practical design exercises; and a written report to confirm learning outcomes. Study Guidance Students are encouraged to observe industrial products critically, analyze their visual characteristics, and reflect on the messages conveyed by their forms in order to deepen their understanding of industrial design and develop design sensibility and skills.
books: Textbook: Peter Dabbs. 2023. Introduction to product design styling. BNN Inc.
requiredKnowledge: 1.No prior knowledge is required; the course is open to students interested in design and design engineering. 2.Design exercises allow flexible methods of expression, including hand drawing, digital drawing software, and CAD. 3.Software exercises focus on creating 2D digital data for cutting machines used in mock-up production.

activityGoals.body: To Understand the purpose of product styling schemes
To be prepared to make novel design proposals.
To understand the type of key elements in product styling.
To be able to identify the type of key elements in product styling on product exterior.
To be able to carry out styling plans with the key elements in product styling.
To be able to visually communicate the intent of planned design to a third party.

achievementLevels.standard: 1) Understood the knowledge involved in product styling. 2) Be able to identify and explain the type of key elements in product styling on the exterior of industrial products. 3) Be able to use the knowledge acquired in this lesson to plan a product styling. 4) Be able to visually express planned design.
